name: steam-dashboard
description: A personal gaming analytics dashboard powered by the Steam Web API, HowLongToBeat, and your local Steam installation.
author: Greg

scripts.build:electron: npm run build && node tools/generate-licenses.mjs && node tools/build-app.mjs

_dependencyNote: Only packages the SERVER needs at runtime belong in dependencies — electron-builder ships exactly that set (and its transitive tree) into the packaged app. react/react-dom are compiled into dist/ by Vite and are never required at runtime, and concurrently only drives the dev scripts, so both live in devDependencies. Listing them as dependencies dragged ~27MB of yargs/chalk/babel into the build.
